ModMetaData.name: Research Retag
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The research normalization made real: techLevel, baseCost and prerequisites rewritten per the frozen manifest (infrastructure/output/research_manifest_draft.csv, owner's frozen deck 2026-09-04). Patches are GENERATED by design/Jawa/research_review/build_retag_patches.py — edit the manifest and regenerate, never the XML.
Scope: surviving rows only; RR_* prereqs excluded (Research Reinvented re-splices its techprints at runtime). Load after every research-adding mod.
RESEARCH_TREE_TABS_1, shipped 2026-09-05: 15 campaign ResearchTabDefs (Defs/ResearchTabDefs/RUT_Tree_Defs.xml) + per-row tab assignment (Patches/RUT_ResearchTabAssign.xml, 403 ops, hand-authored — NOT emitted by build_retag_patches.py, which does not touch tab and still carries the RETAG_BUILDER_SELF_ERASE_1 defect on the techLevel/baseCost slice). Plus the existing RUT_Rites tab = 16 ResearchTabDefs total for the campaign. RUT_Antiquities ships its own tab separately, untouched here. Labels ruled by the owner 2026-09-04: "Jawa Scavenging"/"The Utinni" rename Scavenger/THE SHIP; The Waking Mind ships unfolded, not merged into The Unbolting.
RESEARCH_RETAG_LOAD_ORDER_GAP_1, fixed 2026-09-04: forceLoadAfter below names the packageId of every non-official mod that owns one of the 269 patched ResearchProjectDefs, built from the live def dump's per-def packageId attribution (2026-09-04T02-23-44Z capture, 52 packageIds, 0 unmatched targets) - same convention as FactionSlate. Core/DLC omitted: the engine always loads official content first. Regenerate this list whenever build_retag_patches.py changes the target set.
RESEARCH_TRIO_RETIRE_1 (owner card 2026-09-18): this mod now OWNS 18 native ResearchProjectDefs (Defs/ResearchProjectDefs/RUT_Ported_ResearchTrio.xml) that used to belong to petetimessix.researchreinvented.steppingstones and als.gravtech/als.gravtech.bc, all three retired the same day (infrastructure/state/facts/retired_mods.json). Same defNames as the donors on purpose - every existing cross-reference (RUT_ResearchRetag.xml, RUT_ResearchTabAssign.xml, every OTHER mod's researchPrerequisites) keeps resolving with zero repointing. GravForge's own building, its 6 recipes and 3 supporting items are ported too (Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/ RUT_Ported_GravForge.xml) - the flagship example the ruling named; the rest of the two donors' downstream content (GravWeapon's personal weapons, GravBionics' implants, the 7 AdvShip_* ship parts, als.gravtech.bc's 9 big-cannon buildings) was NOT ported this pass and those research nodes currently unlock nothing of their own - a scoped, named follow-on, not silently invented or silently dropped.
